name: CW Core Specification Set
purpose: Pin the immutable CW Core interpretation bundle with model-global Entity identity, owner-local Property identity, explicit cross-Entity Property addresses, Event-mediated cross-Entity Function boundaries, Comp evaluation semantics, and non-mutating reference degradation when specialized relation interpretation is unavailable.
rules: The bundle selects interpretation authority explicitly; filenames and latest/current discovery are not semantic authority.
Importers produce CW canonical data only. Specification selection happens after import.
Changing the selected specification set changes an evaluation context and MUST NOT silently rewrite the canonical model.
A Comp is an immutable semantic evaluation bundle over compatible NodeTypes, Rulesets and interpretation context; it does not create another CW format or identity model.
Cross-Comp relations remain canonical Link Properties.
If specialized relation semantics are unavailable but canonical endpoints resolve, consumers may expose generic reference/navigation semantics without rewriting the Link.
Known semantic conflicts remain conflicts and are never hidden by fallback.
